messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: service=service-llm-route, target-version=v2. Rollout plan attached: staged feature-flag 'llmroute_v2' will be used for traffic ramp. Health gates: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 latency > 300ms => auto-alert; manual rollback allowed. @oncall pls ack.
Sam: Ack - I'll be watching the canary. Who's owning pin/unpin steps?
Lina: I'll update the release_notes.md with a short blurb: 'llmroute v2: KV cache + batching improvements. Staged ff ramp; rollback safe.'
Ash: Suggest start at 0.1% internal cohort then jump to 1%. Also note session affinity could affect canary signals. Need confirmation on affinity behavior.
oncall: Confirmed: cohort flags use randomized routing, no sticky session by default. Alerts created: model-mismatch > 0.2%, 5xx > 0.5%, p95 > 300ms. I'll post links to dashboards once deploy starts.
Sam: Plan I propose: pin v2 to cohort 'canary-1' at +20s, enable llmroute_v2=0.1% at +30s, ramp -> 1% @ +10m, 10% @ +20m, 50% @ +40m, 100% @ +60m. Manual rollback owner tag?
Lina: @Sam I'll be on-call aware and will hit rollback if alerts trigger and you're not available. :thumbsup:
Jen: I'll run the eval prompt set at +10m and +25m to check quality delta. If algo quality regresses >1.5% we'll call rollback.
Sam: How to pin/unpin quickly? deployctl seems easiest. Example: `deployctl pin --service service-llm-route --version v2 --cohort canary-1`
Lina: For quick ff flips you can use admin API, e.g.:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.dev/flags/llmroute_v2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"percent":0.1}'
```
Sam: Good. I'll sequence automation so deploy-bot steps the API at the ramp times. Manual commands saved in the runbook.
Ash: Reminder: If we see uneven latency across regions, do not continue ramp; pause at current percent and investigate.
oncall: Smoke tests scheduled at +5m and +15m. Will post results here.
deploy-bot: Canary steps scheduled and pinned. Next automated action: pin v2 to canary-1 at 1750010020. Will notify when flag toggles occur.
Sam: Received. I'll watch logs and traces, will call rollback on any emergent regressions.
Lina: Editing release notes now and attaching internal changelog to the release ticket.
Jen: Eval started at +10m, posting quick summary once complete.
oncall: Smoke @ +5m: all good except 3 502s to model-host-3, investigating (low volume). Continuing watch.
Sam: Noting 502 spike; reducing ramp to hold at 0.1% until model-host-3 investigation done. Pausing scheduled ramp.
Lina: Noted. Updating ticket and notifying product.
deploy-bot: Ramp paused by Sam at 1750010500 (operator hold). Next action requires manual resume or rollback.
Ash: I ran a quick probe, model-host-3 had a restart loop due to a probe timeout - fixed and back to healthy. Recommend resume to 1% and observe for 5m.
oncall: Re-run smoke tests now - all clear.
Sam: Resuming: change plan -> 1% now, hold 10m, then continue schedule. I'll announce if anything else pops up.
Lina: Thanks team. Will add a short note to the release summary about the brief hold and restart fix.
Jen: Eval after resume shows quality metrics within expected variance. No rollback needed.
Sam: Final: will continue ramps as scheduled; leave this thread open for any on-the-wire rollbacks. :eyes:
